newsitem.title: USA: OrNda Healthcare buys Fallon unit.
newsitem.headline: OrNda Healthcare buys Fallon unit.

text.p: OrNda HealthCorp said Friday it had completed the acquisition of The Fallon Healthcare System's Saint Vincent Healthcare System.

The company said Saint Vincent consisted of a 432-bed acute care teaching hospital, three skilled nursing facilities and other health-related companies, and a minority interest in the 280-member multispecialty group physician practice, The Fallon Clinic.
The company expects the transaction to be accretive to earnings.
OrNda will fund the construction of a new state-of-the-art replacement hospital, known as Medical City, which will be in downtown Worcester, Mass. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
